title: Desai Liaquat Pact
definition: An informal, abortive agreement reached in January 1945 between Bhulabhai Desai (Leader of Congress Party in Central Legislative Assembly) and Liaquat Ali Khan (Deputy Leader of Muslim League) to form an interim government at the Centre.
importanceInUpsc: It represents a critical phase of 'Constitutional Deadlock' during WWII, highlighting the failed attempts at Congress-League cooperation before the Wavell Plan.
learningOutcomes: Master foundational concepts and mechanisms of Desai Liaquat Pact.
Evaluate spatial distribution, institutional frameworks, and policy dimensions.
Apply high-yield mnemonics to solve tricky Prelims and Mains questions.
